settings.title: Possibly one of the most important, yet overlooked decisions made in the planning of any event, is the equipment package supplied.

settings.editor: The equipment, will carry a good percentage of the success of your function, squarely on its capacity to perform, and perform to a standard.

settings.title: Demand quality, and reliability in the equipment you are supplied.

image.alt: DJ equipment set up for an event

settings.title: Clean and regularly maintained components and media
Brands with a proven track record of performance and reliability
Clear, quality sound for both vocal, and full range music applications
Back up contingencies - you never know!
tested & tagged equipment as required by law, and by qualified persons

settings.editor: My system comes fully self contained. I don’t require any extra equipment from the venue (except 240v power points)

image.alt: Speakers and lighting at a venue

settings.editor: This system suits events catering guest lists from 50, up to 400 people, without over driving the audio system and keeping the sound quality at a premium, while providing enough lighting to keep the dance floor buzzing all night.
Should your event require more, then I am more than happy to arrange a 'custom' package to suit your individual needs - POA.
